raw.query: SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_span_s, d.window_requests, d.tp, d.n_replicas, d.tp * d.n_replicas AS total_gpus, d.superseded_by, MAX(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE p.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms, MAX(i.bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_sla_ms, MAX(i.bound_ms - i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_margin_ms, BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_violation, MAX(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE p.sla_metric = 'itl') AS itl_p99_ms, MAX(i.bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS itl_sla_ms, MAX(i.bound_ms - i.achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS itl_margin_ms, BOOL_OR(i.is_violation) FILTER (WHERE i.sla_metric = 'itl') AS itl_violation, MAX(p.n_requests) AS measured_requests FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = d.run_id AND p.pool IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pool JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.pool IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pool AND i.sla_metric = p.sla_metric WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.run_id = 'sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_tp2_s1' GROUP BY d.run_id, d.window_name, d.window_span_s, d.window_requests, d.tp, d.n_replicas, d.superseded_by
